integrity: A general combinatorial proof uses internal-run rigidity. A standard-library finite test independently verified all complete conjugacy-class sets in 31,840 exhaustive and 1,600 seeded additional configurations. Finite experiments are not substitutes for proof; an unindexed equivalent in the literature cannot be excluded.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification and run-multiset reconstruction concern purely periodic hosts with one positive run per distinct alphabet symbol and q at least two; arbitrary repeated-label motifs, aperiodic hosts and hosts with a preperiod are not covered. The cyclic order of run lengths is not reconstructed.
title: Exact Lie spectra and inverse run rigidity for distinct-letter periodic blocks
